rca.title: Root cause analysis
rca.descriptionBody: Multi-detector agreement (Δz-score 11.12σ spike plus CUSUM and Page-Hinkley drift) localises the fault to the discharge bearing. Regression on the 72-hour trend projects a trip-threshold breach in about 4.5 hours at the current slope of 0.33 mm/s per hour — 13.7× the historical baseline — matching the January 2026 failure pattern. A correlated bearing-housing temperature rise (r = 0.87) rules out sensor drift, confirming a real progressive mechanical fault rather than a transient process event.

root.title: Progressive discharge bearing wear
root.detail: Vibration drifting at 0.33 mm/s per hour — 13.7× faster than the historical baseline. Matches the January 2026 failure signature.

contributing.title: Thermal elevation on the bearing housing
contributing.detail: Bearing temperature sustained 28σ above baseline, peaking at 83.09 °C with zero recovery samples — accelerating lubricant breakdown.

symptom.title: Cascade across five sibling sensors
symptom.detail: Discharge and suction pressure, vibration X and Y, and motor winding temperature all crossed thresholds inside a four-hour window.

operator.name: Operator actions
operator.detail: Escalated to the maintenance lead. No suppression or dismissal recorded against this anomaly.

cascade.body: Five sibling sensors simultaneously anomalous: discharge pressure (critical), suction pressure (critical), vibration X (critical), vibration Y (warning) and motor winding temperature (critical). Multi-sensor correlation indicates a real process event rather than an instrument fault.

ensemble.body: Bearing temperature triggered three detectors: delta_zscore (11.12, confidence 0.9992, spike), cusum (2.31, confidence 0.7832, drift accelerating) and page_hinkley (2.02, confidence 0.7301, drift accelerating). Spike plus sustained drift reads as thermal shock on top of ongoing elevation.

shape.body: Baseline mean 54.02 °C (σ 1.04) over 569 pre-event samples; event peak 83.09 °C, 28.0σ above baseline; zero recovery samples. A sustained excursion with no return to baseline.

history.body: Ten prior critical events in the last seven days, the most recent 1 h 55 m before this one. Not a chronic false-positive emitter — noise ratio 0.0. Sensor profile is 15.17 days old across 527k training samples.

current.body: The current reading of 55.49 °C sits inside P99 (96.6 °C) and the historical range (20–106.8 °C). The detectors flagged rate of change and drift, not absolute value; the event-window peak of 83.09 °C is what exceeds baseline.

sectionIntros.overview: Every source feeding the Forge AI knowledge graph — live signals, business records, documents and media.
sectionIntros.ot: SCADA, PLCs and process historians — the plant’s own control layer. Continuous analogue and digital signals, tag metadata and engineering units, quality codes and the alarm journal. No maintenance records; those come from the systems of record.
sectionIntros.vision: Inspection cameras and thermal arrays. Pass/fail verdicts, defect classes with confidence scores, per-frame region measurements and event stills. Continuous video stays on the edge.
sectionIntros.business: ERP, MES and CMMS — the systems that own equipment master data, work orders, notifications and spare parts. Forge writes back into them using their own transactions rather than becoming a second record.
sectionIntros.stores: Time-series databases, relational tables and object storage. Used for historical backfill when a model needs more history than the live feed carries.
sectionIntros.documents: OEM manuals, SOPs, P&IDs, datasheets and calibration certificates, scoped at instance, model, site or enterprise level so one upload appears everywhere it applies.
sectionIntros.media: Asset photographs, CAD and 3D assemblies, thermal captures and inspection video, linked to the equipment they show.

R-001.name: OEE Summary
R-001.desc: Availability × Performance × Quality with loss decomposition against target. The baseline productivity report.

R-002.name: Six Big Losses Analysis
R-002.desc: Breakdowns, setup, minor stops, reduced speed, process defects and start-up losses, converted to hours and cost.

R-003.name: Line Performance Comparison
R-003.desc: OEE, throughput and changeover benchmarked side by side across every production line, with best-in-class attribution.

R-004.name: Shift Performance
R-004.desc: Crew-level OEE, output attainment, downtime and quality, with shift-over-shift variance.

R-005.name: Throughput & Cycle Time
R-005.desc: Actual against rated cycle time per station, bottleneck identification and takt adherence.

R-010.name: Asset Reliability (MTBF / MTTR)
R-010.desc: Failure rates, MTBF, MTTR and availability per asset class, on the ISO 14224 failure-mode taxonomy.

R-011.name: Predictive Maintenance Effectiveness
R-011.desc: Failures caught before trip against those missed, false-positive rate, lead time achieved and the downtime value avoided.

R-012.name: Maintenance Backlog & Compliance
R-012.desc: Open work orders by age and priority, PM compliance, schedule attainment and overdue exposure.

R-013.name: Planned vs Reactive Mix
R-013.desc: The split between planned, preventive, predictive and reactive work, with wrench-time utilisation.

R-014.name: Root Cause Analysis Summary
R-014.desc: Closed investigations by causal category, recurrence rate and corrective-action effectiveness.

R-015.name: Spare Parts Consumption
R-015.desc: Consumption by machine, stock-out incidents, reorder-point performance and carrying cost.

R-016.name: Critical Spares Coverage
R-016.desc: Cover against critical assets, supplier lead time and obsolescence exposure.

R-020.name: First Pass Yield & Scrap
R-020.desc: FPY, scrap and rework by line, product and defect code, with the cost of poor quality.

R-021.name: SPC & Process Capability
R-021.desc: Control charts, capability indices and out-of-control signals for every critical characteristic.

R-022.name: Defect Pareto & Trend
R-022.desc: Defect codes ranked by frequency and cost, with trend and suspected-source attribution.

R-023.name: Complaints & CAPA
R-023.desc: Complaints by category, CAPA status, closure timeliness and repeat-issue tracking.

R-024.name: Audit Readiness & Nonconformance
R-024.desc: Open nonconformances, corrective actions, document-control status and audit-trail completeness.

R-030.name: Energy Consumption & Intensity
R-030.desc: kWh by machine and line, energy per thousand units, peak-demand profile and off-peak shift opportunity.

R-031.name: Carbon Footprint (Scope 1–2)
R-031.desc: CO₂e by source and scope, intensity per unit produced, and progress against the reduction target.

R-032.name: Compressed Air & Utilities
R-032.desc: Specific power, leak-rate estimation, pressure-band compliance and load-profile optimisation.

R-040.name: Safety Performance (TRIR / LTIFR)
R-040.desc: Recordable incident rate, lost-time frequency, near-misses and the balance of leading indicators.

R-041.name: Integrity Operating Window Compliance
R-041.desc: Time spent outside safe operating limits per parameter, exceedance severity and response times.

R-042.name: Permit to Work & LOTO Audit
R-042.desc: Permits issued and closed, lockout applications, expiry breaches and verification completeness.

R-043.name: Near-Miss & Hazard Observation
R-043.desc: Reporting rate, hazard categories, closure velocity and repeat-location analysis.

R-050.name: Cost of Downtime
R-050.desc: Lost contribution by cause, machine and line, against the cost-per-hour model, with avoided-cost credit.

R-051.name: Manufacturing Cost per Unit
R-051.desc: Material, labour, energy and overhead per unit, with variance to standard cost.

R-052.name: Maintenance Cost & Budget Variance
R-052.desc: Spend by category against budget, cost as a share of replacement asset value, and per-asset lifecycle cost.

R-053.name: Forge AI Value Realisation
R-053.desc: Benefit attribution by stream, ROI, payback, NPV and the before/after baseline comparison.

R-054.name: Board Report
R-054.desc: The quarterly pack: scorecard, site comparison, financial impact, risk register and the decisions being asked for.

R-060.name: Production Plan Attainment
R-060.desc: Actual against planned output by product and line, schedule adherence and backlog carry-over.

R-061.name: Changeover & Setup Analysis
R-061.desc: Changeover duration by product pair, the internal/external setup split, and the best-time benchmark.

R-062.name: Batch Genealogy & Traceability
R-062.desc: Full forward and backward trace for a batch: materials, process parameters, operators and QC results.

R-063.name: Capacity Utilisation & Bottleneck
R-063.desc: Utilisation against rated and demonstrated capacity, constraint identification and headroom.

R-064.name: Shift Carryover & Open Items
R-064.desc: What crossed the shift boundary: open alerts, pending actions and anything the handover left unresolved.
